This is fourth application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.22/2023 dated 09.01.2023, registered at Police Station - Gorakhpur, District - Jabalpur (M.P.) for commission of offence under Section 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 368, 34, 506-II of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
Applicant is in detention since 16.01.2023.

2. Applicant's first three bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 15.05.2023,
passed in M.Cr.C.No.19135/2023, vide order dated 26.06.2023, passed in M.Cr.C.No.25471/2023 and 20.03.2024, passed in M.Cr.C.No.8743/2024.
3.
As per prosecution story on 09.01.2023, 17 years old prosecutrix lodged FIR alleging that she has studied upto Class-IX.
She had developed friendship with accused through one other friend.
On 25.11.2021, Himanshu came to her house at 7:45 PM from his bike and told that he likes her and asked to go along with him.
He took her to his house at Christian Mohalla, Gorakhpur 2 MCRC-27780-2024 and since then she was residing with Himanshu at ground floor of the house.
Sometimes, his sister Shrishti used to meet her.
Himanshu was living with her and in this period he established physical relations with her several times.
He used to threaten her that if she left him he will eliminate her entire family.
FIR was registered.

In her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.PC she along with aforesaid allegations also alleged that Himanshu's parents along with his sister and brother used to live at first floor of the same house.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
Prosecutrix is her wife.

They were having love Himanshu Katariya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61017628/
1 relations and they had entered into wedlock with each other.

sentences.text: No rape/aggravated penetrative sexual assault was committed upon prosecutrix.
They were having consensual sexual relations as husband and wife.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix has been examined before the trial Court and she has not supported the prosecution story.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
5 . O n the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
6 . Prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court.
Now, there is no possibility of influencing of the prosecution witnesses and tempering with the prosecution evidence.

Therefore,
having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case including the fact that final conclusion of trial will take considerable time, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

It is directed that applicant - Himanshu Katariya be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction o f the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
8 . This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Jasleen Himanshu Katariya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61017628/
